meta.title: Kenya's 47 counties: budget, spending, absorption, own-source revenue and pending bills (Controller of Budget annual reports)
meta.rule: Every value carries its table, PDF page, printed page and how it was read. All values were read by OCR (RapidOCR) from scanned pages. A null value has a status (blank, doubtful, or not_in_table when that year’s table has no such column) and a note; doubtful readings keep the raw OCR text. The derived block holds percentages computed from printed amounts for reference only; they are never used as values.

fields.pb_*: pending bills at year end, County Executive and County Assembly
fields.derived: computed by this staging step from the printed amounts (not printed values); for reference only
